Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Anne xure‘1’ Scope of Work/ Services REFURBISHMENT & UPGRADATION OF THE EXISTING CENTRALISED TOOL CONTROL ROOM AT CGAE (SVP) INTERIM HANGAR

Objective: The objective of the work is to refurbish and upgrade the existing Cen tralised Tool Control Room to provide a systematic, functional and well-organized wor king environment. The work includes improvement of storage, work-table facilities, k ey organization, louver integration and associated electrical power distribution. The p roposed modifications are aimed at optimum utilization of available space, safe and c onvenient storage of tools, improved accessibility and better workplace ergonomics. The complete work shall provide a durable, safe, aesthetically improved and operatio nally suitable Tool Control Room. Detailed Scope of Work 1. LOUVER INTEGRATION - 180 SQFT 1.1 Material & Substrate: Supply and installation of approved-grad e 20 mm MDF/BWP-grade plywood substrate with accurately fabricated 12–18 mm th ick decorative louver sections, suitable for interior architectural application. 1.2 Supporting Framework: Provide concealed supporting framework using suitable wooden battens/GI framework, securely anchored to the existing sur face to ensure rigidity, level and stability. 1.3 Louver Configuration: Provide vertically/horizontally oriented lo uver members with uniform spacing, depth and projection, arranged in a consist ent modular pattern to achieve a continuous architectural appearance. 1.4 Surface Finish: Provide approved decorative Sun mica/ laminate/ veneer finish, including proper edge treatment and seamless visual integration w ith the adjoining wall/ panel surfaces. 1.5 Alignment & Spacing: Ensure uniform centre-to-centre spacing, p arallel alignment, consistent projection and straightness throughout the installati on. 1.6 Joint & Edge Treatment: Provide concealed joints, edge profiles, cor ner treatment, terminating members, grooves, recesses and shadow gaps whe rever required for a neat and integrated appearance. 1.7 Completion: The work shall include all cutting, fabrication, framework installation, fixing, surface finishing, alignment, joint treatment, accessories an d other incidental works necessary for complete installation. 2. TABLE EXTENSION REHABILITATION WITH SURFACE LAMINATE INTEG

RATION: - 2.1 Existing Table Assessment: Inspect the existing table and ident ify damaged, loose, uneven or deteriorated portions. Carry out necessary dism antling, rectification and surface preparation. 2.2 Structural Extension: Provide table extension using 20 mm BW P-grade plywood/ MDF or approved equivalent, properly integrated with the e xisting table to achieve the required dimensions, rigidity and load-bearing stability. 2 2.3 Supporting Framework: Provide concealed supporting members usi ng suitable 25 × 25 mm sections/ battens, securely fixed and properly aligne d to ensure stability of the extended table top. 2.4 Surface Substrate: Provide a uniform 18 mm thick substrate over t he existing and extended portions, including levelling, edge alignment and pre paration for final laminate application. 2.5 Laminate Integration: Provide approved decorative 0.8–1.2 mm thick Sunmica/ laminate over the existing and extended table surfaces, firmly bonded using suitable adhesive and properly matched at joints. 2.6 Edge & Joint Treatment: All exposed edges, corners and extension ju nctions shall be properly finished using matching edge bands/ lipping, with join ts securely concealed and treated. 2.7 Final Finishing: The work shall include dismantling, extension, substrat e fixing, laminate application, edge treatment, sanding, alignment, finishing an d all necessary hardware/ accessories. 3. KEY ORGANIZATION PANEL - 4 FT × 32 INCH - QTY 2 3.1 Material & Substrate: Fabricate panels using 18 mm BWP-grade ply wood/ high-density MDF of adequate rigidity and dimensional stability. 3.2 Size & Configuration: Overall panel size shall be 4 ft × 32 inch, accur ately fabricated with properly proportioned layout and adequate usable surfac e area for mounting accessories.

3.3 Mounting Provisions: Provide and securely fix suitable metallic hook s, holders, brackets or equivalent mounting fixtures, arranged in a systematic grid/designated configuration. 3.4 Supporting Arrangement: Provide suitable backing members/inter nal supports wherever required to ensure adequate holding strength, rigidity a nd long-term serviceability. 3.5 Surface Finish: Provide 0.8–1.2 mm thick decorative Sunmica/ appr oved laminate, uniformly bonded over the substrate and properly trimmed to p rovide a smooth and consistent finish. 3.6 Edge & Corner Treatment: All exposed edges, corners, cut-outs a nd junctions shall be finished with matching edge banding/lipping, free from sha rp projections and visible defects. 3.7 Wall Fixing: Securely fix the complete panel assembly to the desig nated wall using suitable heavy-duty anchors, screws, brackets or concealed fi xing arrangements, with proper levelling and vertical alignment. 3.8 Layout & Accessibility: Mounting accessories shall be positioned with uniform spacing and adequate clearance for convenient placement and re moval of items. 3 3.9 Completion: Scope shall include site measurement, cutting, fa brication, substrate preparation, reinforcement, mounting fixture installation, l aminate application, wall fixing, alignment, finishing and all necessary ha rdware. 4. GALVANIZED ENCLOSURE INTEGRATED ASSEMBLY 4.1 Material: Fabrication shall be carried out using GI sheets/ sections of suitable gauge and thickness, providing adequate rigidity, structural stability and durability. 4.2 Configuration: Provide a properly fabricated enclosed storage unit wi th single-door configuration, incorporating organised internal compartments an d adequate usable storage space.

4.3 Upper Compartment: Provide suitable internal clearance and su pporting provisions for systematic storage of garments and other designated a rticles. 4.4 Lower Compartment: Provide properly positioned internal shelve s/divisions for organised storage and convenient accessibility of stored materia ls. 4.5 Door Assembly: Provide a single accurately aligned shutter with sui table hinges, handle and locking arrangement, ensuring smooth operation, sec ure closure and proper fitting. 4.6 Internal Arrangement: Provide suitable internal shelves, stiffener s, partitions and supporting members using compatible GI sections, securely fi xed to maintain rigidity and prevent deformation during regular use. 4.7 Surface Finish: All exposed surfaces shall be properly cleaned, pr epared and finished with suitable protective powder coating/approved protecti ve finish, ensuring uniform appearance and durability. 4.8 Completion: The scope shall include complete fabrication, cutti ng, bending, compartment formation, shutter installation, hardware fixing, surf ace finishing, alignment, installation and all necessary accessories. 5. POWER DISTRIBUTION 5.1 Electrical Infrastructure: Provide complete power distribution arra ngement comprising suitable FRLS copper cables/wires, conduits, junction boxes, mo dular switchgear and associated electrical accessories, selected as per connect ed load and intended application. 5.2 Distribution Arrangement: Power supply shall be distributed throug h a properly configured network of incoming supply, distribution points, switchi ng devices and final circuit connections. 5.3 Cable & Conduit Installation: All electrical wiring shall be routed through concealed PVC/FRLS conduits or approved protective pathways, with ad equate segregation, proper bending radius and secure support. 5.4 Protection & Switching: Provide suitable MCB/ RCCB/ RCBO, isolato rs and other protective devices, wherever required, with appropriate curr ent/fault ratings for protection against overload, short circuit and earth leakag e. 4 5.5 Electrical Point Provisioning: Provide required power points, switc h points, socket outlets and dedicated connections as per approved layout, inc luding proper termination, polarity, identification and accessibility. 5.6 Earthing & Safety: Provide proper earthing, continuity and protectiv

e earth connections for all applicable circuits and metallic components. Al l terminations shall be properly tightened, insulated and protected agains t accidental contact. 5.7 Testing & Completion: Complete installation, testing, rectification and commissioning of the electrical system, including all necessary cable s, conduits, fittings, accessories and incidental works. 6. FLEXIBLE SHEETING SUPPLY & INSTALLATION 6.1 Material: Provide and install flexible elastomeric sheeting manuf actured from high-grade rubber compound, having suitable flexibility, resilience an d durability for the intended application. 6.2 Thickness: Sheeting shall be 3–6 mm thick, or as specified in th e approved estimate/BOQ, with uniform thickness throughout and free fro m cracks, pinholes, blisters or manufacturing defects. 6.3 Surface Properties: Both surfaces shall have uniform, smooth and pr operly finished texture suitable for the intended application and consiste nt contact. 6.4 Flexibility & Resilience: The sheeting shall possess adequate flexibility, elasticity and recovery characteristics to withstand normal bending, com pression, movement and repeated handling without cracking, tearing or perman ent deformation. 6.5 Dimensional Stability & Resistance: The material shall maintain its specified dimensions during normal use and provide suitable resistance ag ainst moisture, abrasion, mechanical wear and environmental exposure. 6.6 Cutting & Installation: The sheeting shall be accurately measur ed, cut and positioned as per the required dimensions, with clean edges, properly a ligned joints and secure fixing wherever required. 6.7 Complete Finishing: The scope shall include supply, measurem ent, cutting, preparation, fitting, fixing and final positioning of flexible sheeting, including all necessary accessories, joint treatment and finishing, complete in all re spects. . 4.
